name: pulse-analytics-workspace
description: Root workspace orchestrator for Pulse Analytics

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm start
scripts.start: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm run start:backend" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
